text: Every measure and relationship you've built lives inside what the service now calls a semantic model — the modern name for what used to be called a dataset.

Three ways a semantic model gets its data. Import copies data in for speed, but needs refreshing. DirectQuery queries the source live for currency, at the cost of speed. Composite mixes both in one model.
Sometimes a model already lives outside Power BI entirely, in Analysis Services. A live connection passes every query straight through instead of copying anything in.
Not every user who opens a semantic model can edit it — ownership and row-level security both control that. Lesson 72 covers sharing access properly.
